14. A solid metal right circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(A\) and a frustum \(B\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of \(A\) are \(6\) cm and \(8\) cm respectively. The curved surface area of \(B\) is \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(i) the curved surface area of \(A\),
(ii) the volume of \(B\).

(b) The frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into \(12\) identical solid right circular cylinders. The height of each circular cylinder is \(13\) cm. Find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(A\) 及一個截頭錐 \(B\)。\(A\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(8\) cm，\(B\) 的曲面面積為 \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(i) \(A\) 的曲面面積；
(ii) \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將截頭錐 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成 \(12\) 個相同的實心直立圓柱，每個圓柱高 \(13\) cm，求每個圓柱的底半徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a)(i) The slant height of \(A\) is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the curved surface area of \(A\) is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (a)(ii) Let the base radius of the original large cone be \(r\) cm. Since the curved surface areas of similar cones are proportional to the squares of corresponding lengths, \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{60\pi}{60\pi+480\pi}.\) Thus \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{1}{9},\) so \(r=18.\) By similarity, the height of the original large cone is \(8\left(\frac{18}{6}\right)=24\text{ cm}.\) The volume of cone \(A\) is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let the volume of \(B\) be \(V\text{ cm}^3\). Since volumes of similar cones are proportional to the cubes of corresponding lengths, \(\frac{96\pi}{96\pi+V}=\left(\frac{6}{18}\right)^3=\frac{1}{27}.\) Hence \(2592\pi=96\pi+V,\) so \(V=2496\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(B\) is \(2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of each circular cylinder be \(R\) cm. Then \[12\pi R^2(13)=2496\pi.\] Thus \[R^2=16,\] so \[ R=4. \] Therefore, the base radius of each circular cylinder is \[4\text{ cm}.\]

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（3 分）

(c) 沿一個平行於底面的平面切除 \(Y\) 的上部，造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。求 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。（2 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[\pi(20)^2(8.4)=3360\pi.\] Since the ratio of the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) is \(4:9\), the ratio of their radii is \(2:3\), and the ratio of their volumes is \(2^3:3^3=8:27.\) Therefore \(\text{volume of }Y=\frac{27}{8+27}(3360\pi)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and its height be \(4k\). \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=2592\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=2592,\) so \(k=6.\) Hence \(r=18\) and \(h=24\). The slant height is \(\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\) The curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar and the ratio of their heights is \(2:3\), \[\text{height of }X=\frac{2}{3}(24)=16.\] The height of \(Z\) is \(16\), so the removed small cone has height \(8\). Its scale factor compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{8}{24}=\frac13.\) Therefore the curved surface area of the removed small cone is \(540\pi\left(\frac13\right)^2=60\pi.\) The curved surface area of \(Z\) is \(540\pi-60\pi=480\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (8 marks)

The claim is not agreed. (8 marks)

(b) 求小正方形底錐與大正方形底錐的總表面積之比。

questions.solution: 13. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of a smaller square pyramid. The largest square pyramid cut from each cube has square base side \(12\) cm and height \(12\) cm. Hence \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3 =4\left(12^3-\frac{1}{3}\cdot 12^2\cdot 12\right).\] Therefore \[9h^3=4608\] and \(h=8\). The height of a smaller square pyramid is \(8\) cm. (b) The ratio of corresponding lengths of a smaller pyramid to a larger pyramid is \(8:12=2:3\). Therefore the ratio of their total surface areas is \[2^2:3^2=4:9.\] (c) I do not agree. If the side of each original cube is \(a\) cm, the largest square pyramid cut off from each cube has volume \(\frac{1}{3}a^3\). The total volume recast is \[4\left(a^3-\frac{1}{3}a^3\right)=\frac{8}{3}a^3.\] If the height of each smaller similar square pyramid is \(h\), then \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3=\frac{8}{3}a^3,\] so \(h=\frac{2a}{3}\). The corresponding length ratio is always \(2:3\), so the surface area ratio is always \(4:9\).

13. The slant height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 82 cm and 18 cm respectively. The circular cone is melted and recast into three similar solid right circular cylinders. Denote these three circular cylinders by \(A, B\) and \(C\). It is given that the ratio of the base area of \(A\) to the base area of \(B\) to the base area of \(C\) is \(4: 9: 25\).

(a) Find the volume of \(C\).

(b) There are two solid hemispheres. The radii of the two hemispheres are equal to the base radii of \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. If the sum of the curved surface areas of the two hemispheres is \(234 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\), find the height of \(C\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的斜高及底半徑分別為 \(82\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐熔化後重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓柱，記為 \(A\)、\(B\) 及 \(C\)。已知 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9:25\)。

(a) 求 \(C\) 的體積。

(b) 有兩個實心半球，半徑分別等於 \(A\) 及 \(B\) 的底半徑。若兩個半球的曲面面積和為 \(234\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，求 \(C\) 的高。

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。

questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the circular cone \[=\sqrt{82^{2}-18^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}\] \[=80 \mathrm{~cm}\] The ratio of the volume of \(A\) to the volume of \(B\) to the volume of \(C\) \[=(\sqrt{4})^{3}:(\sqrt{9})^{3}:(\sqrt{25})^{3}\] \[=(2)^{3}:(3)^{3}:(5)^{3}\] \[=8: 27: 125\] The volume of \(C\) \[=\frac{1}{3} \pi(18)^{2}(80)\left(\frac{125}{8+27+125}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=6750 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(C\). The base radius of \(A\) is \(\frac{2}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\) and the base radius of \(B\) is \(\frac{3}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{2}{5} r\right)^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{3}{5} r\right)^{2} =234 \pi \\ \frac{26}{25} r^{2} =234 \\ r^{2} =225 \\ r =15\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(C\). \(\pi r^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ \pi(15)^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ h =30\) Thus, the height of \(C\) is 30 cm . for the formula of the volume of a cone volume of a cylinder

The base radius of \(Y\) is \(10\) cm. \(Z\) is melted and recast into a solid metal hemisphere. The total surface area of the hemisphere is \(432\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express the volume of the hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Does the total surface area of the hemisphere exceed the total surface area of \(Z\)? Explain your answer. (5 marks)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求半球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 半球的總表面積是否超過 \(Z\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the hemisphere be \(r\) cm. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Given that \[3\pi r^2=432\pi,\] we have \[r^2=144,\] so \[ r=12. \] Therefore, the volume of the hemisphere is \[\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)\] \[=\frac23\pi(12)^3\] \[=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Let the height of cone \(X\) be \(h\) cm. Since cone \(Y\) and cone \(X\) are similar, the height of cone \(Y\) is \[\frac{10}{14}h=\frac57h.\] Thus the volume of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right).\] Since \(Z\) is recast into the hemisphere, \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right)=1152\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{872}{21}h=1152,\] so \[h=\frac{3024}{109}.\] The height of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac27h=\frac{6048}{763}.\] The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{\left(\frac{6048}{763}\right)^2+(14-10)^2}\] \[\approx 8.878686548.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(14^2)+\pi(10^2)+\pi(14+10)(8.878686548).\] Therefore, \[\text{total surface area of }Z\approx 1599.35\text{ cm}^2.\] But \[432\pi\approx 1357.17\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[1357.17<1599.35,\] the total surface area of the hemisphere does not exceed the total surface area of \(Z\). (5 marks)

It is given that the base area of a larger circular cylinder is \(9\) times that of a smaller one.

(a) Find

(i) \(r:R\),
(ii) the height of a larger circular cylinder.

(b) A craftsman claims that a smaller circular cylinder and a larger circular cylinder are similar. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

13. 某工作坊將 \(2\) 個底半徑 \(R\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成 \(27\) 個底半徑 \(r\) cm、高 \(10\) cm 的較小相同實心直立圓柱。已知較大圓柱的底面積為較小圓柱的 \(9\) 倍。

(a) 求

(i) \(r:R\)；
(ii) 較大圓柱的高。

(b) 某工匠聲稱較小圓柱與較大圓柱相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）

questions.solution: (a)(i) \(\frac{\pi r^2}{\pi R^2}=\frac19.\) Thus \(\frac{r}{R}=\frac13,\) so \(r:R=1:3.\) (a)(ii) Let the height of a larger cylinder be \(h\) cm. By conservation of volume, \(2\pi R^2h=27(\pi r^2)(10).\) Thus \(h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^2 =135\left(\frac13\right)^2=15.\) (b) The radius ratio smaller:larger is \(1:3\), but the height ratio smaller:larger is \[10:15=2:3.\] The ratios are not equal, so the cylinders are not similar. The claim is disagreed. Final answers: (a)(i) \(1:3\); (a)(ii) \(15\) cm; (b) disagree.

The heights of \(X\) and \(Y\) are \(20\text{ cm}\) and \(24\text{ cm}\) respectively. The volume of the solid right circular cone \(Z\) is equal to the sum of the volume of \(X\) and the volume of \(Y\). The base radius of \(Z\) is equal to the base diameter of \(X\). A craftsman finds that the volume of \(Y\) is \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(a) Find the base radius of \(Y\).

(b) Are \(Y\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.

(c) The craftsman claims that the sum of the curved surface area of \(X\) and the curved surface area of \(Y\) is greater than the curved surface area of \(Z\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 實心直立圓柱 \(X\) 的底半徑與實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 的底半徑相等。\(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。實心直立圓錐 \(Z\) 的體積等於 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積之和，\(Z\) 的底半徑等於 \(X\) 的底直徑。某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的體積為 \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的底半徑。

(b) \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

(c) 該工匠聲稱 \(X\) 的曲面面積與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積之和大於 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）

questions.solution: (a) Let the common base radius of \(X\) and \(Y\) be \(r\). \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=800\pi\] so \[8r^2=800,\qquad r=10.\] (b) The base radius of \(Z\) is \(20\). The volume of \(X\) is \[\pi(10)^2(20)=2000\pi.\] Thus the volume of \(Z\) is \(2800\pi\). Since the radius ratio \(Y:Z=10:20=1:2\) but the volume ratio \(800\pi:2800\pi=2:7\ne 1:8\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not similar. (c) The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[2\pi(10)(20)=400\pi.\] The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26\), so the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi(10)(26)=260\pi.\] For \(Z\), \[\frac13\pi(20)^2h=2800\pi\] so \(h=21\), and its slant height is \(\sqrt{20^2+21^2}=29\). Hence the curved surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20)(29)=580\pi.\] Since \[400\pi+260\pi=660\pi>580\pi,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(10\text{ cm}\); (b) no; (c) agree.

(a) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立錐體的底面為正方形，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(Z\) 及一個錐體。\(Z\) 的高及總表面積分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(960\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

Final answers: (a) \(18944\text{ cm}^3\); (b) not similar.

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a circular cone \(T\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is \(16\) cm. questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a frustum \(P\) and a right circular cone \(Q\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(Q\) is 24 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(75\) cm 及 \(40\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(Q\)。已知 \(Q\) 的高為 \(24\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution:
(a) The small cone has radius \(75(24/40)=45\) cm. The original and small slant heights are 85 and 51 cm, so the frustum slant height is 34 cm. Its curved area is \(\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Including both circular faces, the total is \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
(b) P has height 16 cm and volume \(\pi[(75)^2(40)-(45)^2(24)]/3=58800\pi\text{ cm}^3\). The volume ratio P:R is 8:1, so similarity would require a height ratio 2:1. The actual height ratio is 16:7. They are not similar.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 小圓錐半徑為 \(75(24/40)=45\) cm。大、小圓錐斜高分別為 85、51 cm，故截頭錐斜高為 34 cm。曲面積為 \(\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。加上兩個圓形底面，總表面積為 \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。
(b) P 高為 16 cm，體積為 \(58800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。P:R 體積比為 8:1，若相似則高度比應為 2:1，但實際為 16:7，所以不相似。
